rules.title: Async all the way
rules.body: Do not block on tasks with .Result, .Wait() or GetAwaiter().GetResult(); await them. Pass the CancellationToken through every async call that accepts one. async void only for event handlers.

rules.title: Dispose what you create
rules.body: IDisposable and IAsyncDisposable objects are created in using statements or declarations. HttpClient instances come from IHttpClientFactory, never new HttpClient() per call.

rules.title: No null-forgiving to silence warnings
rules.body: Do not use the ! null-forgiving operator to silence nullable warnings where the value can really be null; handle the null case.

rules.title: Rethrow with throw;
rules.body: Rethrow caught exceptions with throw; (not throw ex;) to keep the stack trace, and never catch exceptions only to ignore them.

rules.title: EF Core reads without tracking
rules.body: Read-only EF Core queries use AsNoTracking(), project to what they need, and load related data with Include or projections instead of per-row queries.
